Indian Railways launches app for real-time train information

Indian Railways has launched a new mobile application named 'Punctuality BZA'. The app is designed to provide users with crucial, real-time information about train schedules and punctuality. This initiative aims to keep passengers informed about train updates on a minute-by-minute basis.
